text: Planting a garden can be a rewarding experience, especially when you prioritize pruning, watering, and observation. Begin by pruning your plant to maintain the overall health of the plant and encourage new growth. Remove any dead or diseased leaves to prevent the spread of diseases and pests. Watering is also crucial, especially during hot weather, as it helps to keep the soil moist but not waterlogged. Lastly, observe your garden regularly, noting any signs of pests or diseases, to address any issues promptly and keep your plants thriving. With proper care and attention, your garden will flourish, providing you with fresh produce and a beautiful space to enjoy.
